description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named Supervisor, which is used within the OrangeHRM system to represent supervisor information related to employees in reports. It handles normalization of supervisor data, retrieves supervisor details from the Employee entity, and includes logic to fetch reporting methods through service dependencies.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates supervisor data associated with an employee, providing methods to serialize data and fetch specific supervisor-related information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Supervisor DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the supervisor data into an array format based on specified fields.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Custom logic to retrieve specific fields from Employee entities, notably fetching reporting method names for supervisors.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of report fields to getter methods on the Employee entity.
